blind.description: A stylized dual-peaked rock formation or stalagmite cluster consisting of one taller spire and one shorter spire joined at an organic, stepped base. The surface features layered, scalloped flowstone or drip tiers with cream-colored highlights over earthy brown and terracotta rock tones. The geometry is solid, continuous, and rounded without holes, floating shards, or separate plinths, resting directly on a flat base.
blind.from_above: A rounded figure-eight or peanut-shaped footprint showing two concentric circular peaks (one larger than the other) surrounded by wavy, stepped base tiers, casting a dual shadow to the upper left.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in scale figure (about 2 ft tall) and approximately 1.5 to 2 ft wide at the base.
